steps.title: Prepare ACK lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.15 M NH₄Cl, 10 mM KHCO₃ and 0.1 mM EDTA in deionized H₂O, adjust the pH to 7.3, filter the solution through a 0.2 µm sterile filter and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Differentiate THP‑1‑derived macrophages
steps.instruction: Generate PMA‑differentiated THP‑1 macrophages in a 24‑well plate and prepare compensation‑control cells.

substeps.instruction: Harvest THP‑1 cells from a 175 cm² flask grown in RPMI‑1640 with 10 % FBS, 1 % GlutaMAX™ and 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin; keep all media and buffers pre‑warmed.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 400 × g for 5 min at room temperature, discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 5 mL PBS; count cells.
Transfer 2.4 × 10⁷ cells to a clear 50 mL conical tube (Tube A) and 4.0 × 10⁶ cells to a second tube (Tube B); centrifuge both tubes at 400 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant.
Resuspend Tube B pellet in fresh RPMI‑c at 4.0 × 10⁶ cells/mL (1 × 10⁷ cells in 2.4 mL PBS) for compensation controls; keep at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until seeding.

Resuspend Tube A pellet in 2.4 mL PBS (1.0 × 10⁷ cells/mL). Add CellTrace™ Violet or CFSE (working 5 µM) at a 1:1,000 dilution, flick to mix and incubate 20 min at 37 °C in a water bath protected from light.
Add five‑fold volume of pre‑warmed RPMI‑c, incubate 5 min at 37 °C, then centrifuge 400 × g for 5 min.
Rinse the pellet with 10 mL pre‑warmed RPMI‑c, centrifuge again, discard supernatant and resuspend in 6 mL RPMI‑c (4.0 × 10⁶ cells/mL).
Seed 250 µL (1.0 × 10⁶ cells) from each tube into each well of a 24‑well plate (final volume 500 µL per well).
Prepare PMA at 100 ng/mL in RPMI‑c; add 250 µL to each well (final PMA concentration 50 ng/mL).
Incubate 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Aspirate medium, add 500 µL fresh RPMI‑c and incubate another 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Macrophages are now ready for the efferocytosis assay.

steps.title: Differentiate PBMC‑derived macrophages
steps.instruction: Isolate PBMCs from an LRS cone, label, seed and mature them into adherent macrophages.

substeps.instruction: Collect the leukocyte reduction system (LRS) cone, keep on ice (4 °C) until use; lock one access with forceps, cut the opposite access with sterile scissors.
Insert a 23 G needle attached to a 5 mL syringe, aspirate the blood, and transfer up to 2.5 mL into a 50 mL conical tube (split into two tubes if needed).
Add 35 mL cold PBS to the sample, mix by up‑and‑down pipetting.
In a separate 50 mL tube add 13 mL Histopaque®‑1077; carefully overlay the cell suspension onto the Histopaque surface using a disposable Pasteur pipette without mixing.
Centrifuge the gradient at 640 × g for 30 min at 4 °C (medium acceleration, brake off).
Discard the top plasma/thrombocyte layer with a Pasteur pipette, then collect the PBMC interface layer into a new 50 mL tube.
Resuspend the PBMCs in 25 mL cold PBS, centrifuge 400 × g for 5 min, discard PBS.
Resuspend the pellet in 5 mL cold ACK lysis buffer, incubate on ice 5 min, then add 25 mL PBS, mix and centrifuge 400 × g for 5 min.
Discard PBS, resuspend cells in 5 mL pre‑warmed PBS, count.
Transfer 2.4 × 10⁸ PBMCs to Tube A and 4.0 × 10⁷ PBMCs to Tube B (for compensation controls); centrifuge both tubes, discard PBS.
Resuspend Tube B pellet in 2 mL RPMI without serum (2.0 × 10⁷ cells/mL) and keep at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until seeding.
Resuspend Tube A pellet in 2.4 mL pre‑warmed PBS (1.0 × 10⁸ cells/mL).

Label the cells with CellTrace™ Violet or CFSE (5 µM working solution) as in steps A4a–A4d (add dye 1:1,000, incubate 20 min at 37 °C protected from light, add 5× volume media, incubate 5 min, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min, wash with 10 mL RPMI).
After washing, resuspend the labeled PBMC pellet in 12 mL RPMI without serum (2.0 × 10⁷ cells/mL).
Seed 500 µL (1.0 × 10⁷ cells) of the suspension into each well of a 24‑well plate; gently swirl to distribute.
Reserve 2–3 wells for later confluence check.
Incubate 1 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, then rinse each well three times with pre‑warmed PBS to remove non‑adherent cells.
Aspirate all medium and add 1 mL RPMI supplemented with 10 % human serum (RPMIh) per well; incubate 72 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Add another 1 mL fresh RPMIh and incubate a further 72 h under the same conditions.
Lift macrophages from the 2–3 reserved wells with a cell scraper, count to confirm confluence. The differentiated macrophages are now ready for the efferocytosis assay.

steps.title: Generate stained apoptotic Jurkat cells
steps.instruction: Produce UV‑irradiated apoptotic Jurkat cells labeled with either CellTrace™ Far Red or pHrodo™ Red for use as targets in the efferocytosis assay.

substeps.instruction: Harvest Jurkat cells from a 175 cm² flask grown in RPMI‑c; keep all reagents pre‑warmed.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at room temperature, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 5 mL fresh RPMI‑c and count.
Transfer 3.0 × 10⁷ cells to a 50 mL conical tube, centrifuge, discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 3 mL fresh RPMI‑c.
Plate the suspension in a 100 mm × 20 mm tissue‑culture dish.
Irradiate the dish with a UV cross‑linker at 50 mJ/cm².
Collect the irradiated cells into Tube A; rinse the dish with 9 mL PBS and add the rinse to Tube A.
Aliquot 2.0 mL of the suspension (5.0 × 10⁶ cells) into Tube B; centrifuge both tubes, discard supernatant.
Resuspend the Tube B pellet in 10 mL fresh RPMI‑c (these will become the FMO control cells).
Centrifuge the remaining cells in Tube A, discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 3 mL PBS (1.0 × 10⁷ cells/mL).

Label the cells with CellTrace™ Far Red (1 µM working) **or** pHrodo™ Red (5 nM working) using the same labeling scheme as in steps A4a–A4d (add dye 1:1,000, incubate 20 min at 37 °C protected from light, add 5× volume media, incubate 5 min, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min, wash with 10 mL RPMI‑c).
Resuspend the labeled cells in 10 mL fresh RPMI‑c and transfer the suspensions from Tubes A and B to separate tissue‑culture dishes.
Incubate 4 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ to allow apoptosis to proceed.
Collect the apoptotic cells (ACs) from each dish into separate 50 mL conical tubes; rinse each dish with 10 mL pre‑warmed PBS and add the rinse to the corresponding tube.
Centrifuge the AC tubes, discard supernatant and resuspend the pellets in 5 mL RPMI‑c (for THP‑1 assays) or RPMIh (for PBMC assays).
Count cells and adjust the concentration to 5.0 × 10⁶ AC/mL with the appropriate medium. The AC suspensions are now ready for the efferocytosis assay.

steps.title: Efferocytosis assay and flow‑cytometry preparation
steps.instruction: Co‑culture labeled macrophages with labeled and unlabeled apoptotic Jurkat cells, then stain with Zombie NIR and fix for flow‑cytometric analysis.

substeps.instruction: Rinse the CFSE‑labeled macrophage plate with 500 µL pre‑warmed PBS per well.
Add 200 µL of the labeled AC1 suspension (from Tube A) to each experimental well (final macrophage:AC ratio ≈1:1).
Add 200 µL of the unlabeled AC1 suspension (from Tube B) to each FMO‑AC1 control well.
Gently swirl the plate to distribute the ACs and incubate:
• For a single‑uptake experiment: 2 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
• For continual efferocytosis: 18 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
If performing continual efferocytosis, after the first incubation remove medium, rinse each well three times with 500 µL pre‑warmed PBS, then:
Add 200 µL labeled AC2 (Tube A) to experimental wells and 200 µL unlabeled AC2 (Tube B) to FMO‑AC2 control wells; swirl and incubate 2 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Rinse each well three times with 500 µL PBS, then add 200 µL PBS.
Detach the cells with a cell scraper (clean scraper between groups) and transfer the cell suspensions into FACS tubes.
Prepare Zombie NIR viability dye by diluting it 1:400 in PBS (enough for all samples; 50 µL staining volume per tube).
Centrifuge the tubes at 400 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant and resuspend each pellet in 50 µL Zombie NIR solution.
Incubate on ice for 10 min in the dark, then centrifuge again at 400 × g for 5 min.
Discard the dye solution and rinse the cells twice with 500 µL PBS per tube.
If fixation is required, resuspend the pellet in 250 µL PBS containing 2 % paraformaldehyde and incubate 15 min on ice; otherwise resuspend in 250 µL PBS.
Proceed to data acquisition on a flow cytometer.
